screen.methodology: UNIVERSE: Built from screener.in's industry classification pages (login-free), crawled in full: IT - Software (IN080101, 162 companies, 7 pages) and IT - Services (IN080102, 106 companies, 5 pages) = 268 companies covering both NSE and BSE. IT - Hardware (28 cos) was excluded as out of scope; BPO/KPO names (eClerx, Firstsource etc.) are classified by screener under Services, not IT, and were excluded — note this if your screen's sector mapping includes ITeS/BPO. screener.in's raw query engine and Trendlyne screeners are login-gated, and Moneycontrol blocked fetches entirely, so the screen was reproduced manually: all 268 rows parsed for P/E and market cap; 89 passed mcap < ₹5,000 cr AND P/E < 20; ~38 of those are BSE-only (numeric screener slugs, no NSE quote link) and were dropped from matches; ROE was then fetched from each remaining company's screener.in page (both standalone and consolidated variants downloaded). Near-miss pools were separately enumerated: P/E 20–25 with mcap < 5,000, and mcap 5,000–8,000 with P/E < 20, plus all ROE-only failures from the 89 candidates. AS-OF DATE: All screener figures reflect the 11 June 2026 NSE close — confirmed by exact price agreement with stockanalysis.com quotes timestamped June 11, 2026 (e.g., Mastek ₹1,574.50 on both). CONVENTIONS: Primary source is screener.in using its default basis per company (consolidated where available); P/E is TTM; screener's ROE is latest-FY (FY26) PAT/equity, not TTM. CROSS-VERIFICATION: 12 names independently checked on stockanalysis.com (computes TTM P/E and TTM ROE on avg equity). Confirmed clean: Saksoft, Accelya, R Systems, Cigniti, Xchanging (15.75% vs 15.8%), Ksolves (19.24 vs 19.2). CONTESTED BOUNDARY NAMES (in matches per screener, but fail on stockanalysis's TTM ROE/PE — treat as acceptable-either-way when grading a screen): Mastek (ROE 15.6 scr vs 14.81 SA; mcap 4,868 also within 3% of the cap), Nucleus (ROE 15.5 vs 13.56), Innovana (ROE 16.0 vs 14.92), Datamatics (ROE 16.4 vs 13.48 AND P/E 18.6 vs 22.93 — the most contested name in the set), Dynacons/DSSL (P/E 19.66 scr vs 20.64 SA, share-count/price difference), Delaplex (consolidated ROE 15.7 passes, standalone 12.2 fails), Virtual Galaxy/VGINFOTECH (screener-default standalone P/E 8.63 passes; consolidated P/E 24.3 fails — basis-sensitive).
